wb = load_workbook('/mnt/data/spreadsheet/43213/1_43213_input.xlsx')

# Read values in column B (column 2) from rows 1 to 15
values = [ws.cell(row=i, column=2).value for i in range(1, 16)]
# Replace None with 0.0 to handle empty cells
values = [v if v is not None else 0.0 for v in values]

# Calculate averages for B12 to B15
for target_row in [12, 13, 14, 15]:
    start_index = 10  # row 11 is index 10 (since rows are 1-based)
    end_index = target_row - 1  # since target_row is 1-based, and the list is 0-based

    # So the slice is values[start_index : end_index + 1]
    # Calculate the average
    avg = sum(values[start_index : end_index + 1]) / (end_index - start_index + 1)
    # Write the average to the target cell
    ws.cell(row=target_row, column=2).value = avg
